description: Search locally captured screen text and audio transcripts, recall meetings, and summarize work through Screenpipe MCP. Requires a running Screenpipe recorder at localhost:3030 and its local API key on the same machine as the MCP process. Source-available under the Screenpipe Commercial License. Configured AI clients, cloud transcription, sync, or integrations may send context off-device.

SCREENPIPE_LOCAL_API_KEY.description: Local Screenpipe API key. Obtain with screenpipe auth token or use the desktop app Settings > Connections. Set explicitly to avoid slower automatic key discovery. Requires Screenpipe running at localhost:3030.

name: Screenpipe MCP
